name: Dean Kuriakose
profileSummary: Dean Kuriakose is an Indian politician from Kerala and a member of the Indian National Congress. Dean Kuriakose was the president of the Youth Congress Kerala wing of Indian Youth Congress. He was elected as member of parliament from Idukki Lok Sabha constituency in 2019 with record lead of 171,053 votes. He was also elected as member of parliament from Idukki Lok Sabha constituency in 2024 with lead of 133,727 votes.
